audiences.title: Audiences
audiences.subtitle: Build groups of people from your CRM, send them to Meta and Google, and grow lookalikes. Only people who may lawfully receive marketing are uploaded, as hashed emails and phone numbers.
audiences.none_yet: No audiences yet. Describe who you want to reach, or build a segment from your CRM.
audiences.delete_confirm: Delete this audience here and remove it from Meta and Google?
audiences.name: Name
audiences.describe_hint: For example: qualified leads from the website added this year, or contacts in construction in Durban who bought from us.
audiences.ai_says: AI suggestion — check the filters before saving
audiences.consent_explicit: Only people who gave marketing consent
audiences.consent_opt_out: Existing customers and enquirers who have not opted out (s69(3))
audiences.consent_opt_out_hint: Use this only for people who gave you their details during a sale or enquiry and were offered an opt-out.
audiences.reason_suppressed: On a suppression list (unsubscribed or blocked)
audiences.visitors_hint: Website-visitor audiences need the Meta pixel or Google tag on your site. Without one, sync says so instead of creating an empty list.
audiences.lookalike_hint: Meta finds people similar to this audience. The audience must be synced to Meta first, with at least 100 matched people.
audiences.campaign_audiences_hint: Target or exclude audiences on each network. Only audiences already synced to a network are applied there.
audiences.not_on_network: Not on {network} yet — sync it on the Audiences page
audiences.lead_form_hint: People enquire inside the ad without visiting your site. Each lead goes into the CRM against this campaign and counts as a conversion.
audiences.headline: Headline
audiences.questions: Name, email and phone are always asked. Extra questions:
audiences.attach_google_form: Add to the live Google campaign
audiences.webhooks: Webhook addresses (set once in the Meta app and taken automatically by Google)
